global_extents.usage: diagnostic-only; copied from DXF HEADER and not a site measurement

warnings.message: This reader does not expand blocks or create professional CAD objects.
A summary match is evidence for review, not approval for quantities or construction.
Counts and names can match while block transforms or topology still differ; professional review remains required.
The DXF is a separate source and does not overwrite the registered DWG or its derived artifacts.
Do not use this report as approval for construction drawings, quantities, pricing, or site setting-out.
